newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rouen July-Jan grain exports rose yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Rouen July-Jan grain exports rose yr/yr.

text.p: PARIS, Feb 18 Reuter) - Grain exports from the French port of Rouen rose to 3.502 million tonnes in the first seven months of the 1996/97 season (July/June) from 2.975 million tonnes exported during the same period of 1995/96, port officials said on Tuesday.
Italy, Algeria, Morocco, Egypt and west Africa were the main destinations for French wheat between July 1, 1996, and January 31, 1997, they said.
Grain exports to Egypt, which resumed in October, had reached 321,000 tonnes on January 31.
Rouen also shipped 167,000 tonnes of grain to Cuba during the first seven months of the 1996/97 season.
But grain exports slowed down in January 1997 to 489,000 tonnes from 861,000 tonnes in December 1996.
One official said business was now mostly focused on traditional north African buyers.
